options.content:
**How to read this dashboard**

- **All AI figures on this dashboard are Claude Code OTel-only**, scoped to the Project and Claude Code OTel Teams filters above. Legacy Claude Admin-API and Cursor activity are excluded — neither carries a reliable per-project mapping. Every "per merged PR" ratio below (AI Lines/PR, Tokens/PR, Cost/PR) now scopes the PR side to the same Project filter as the AI side, so the ratio stays meaningful at any Project selection. PR Size (p85/median) has no AI-mixing problem and stays scoped to the Project filter as normal.
- AI spend and tokens come solely from `ai_model_usages`, which only Claude Code OTel writes to.
- MySQL has no built-in percentile function; p85/median below are computed exactly via row-numbering over the full distribution, not approximated.

panels.description: Total AI-generated lines added, Claude Code OTel-only, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.lines_added)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS "AI Lines Generated"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: AI Lines Generated

panels.description: Total AI tokens consumed, Claude Code OTel-only, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_model_usages.*_tokens)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS "Tokens Burned"
FROM ai_model_usages
WHERE source_connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
)
AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Tokens Burned

panels.description: Total estimated AI spend, Claude Code OTel-only, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_model_usages.estimated_cost_usd)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(estimated_cost_usd), 2) AS "Cost"
FROM ai_model_usages
WHERE source_connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
)
AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Cost

panels.description: Merged pull requests, scoped to the selected project(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Merged"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)

panels.title: PRs Merged

panels.description: AI lines added ÷ PRs merged, both sides scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(ai.n / NULLIF(prs.n, 0), 1) AS "AI Lines / PR"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(lines_added) n FROM ai_activities
   WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
     AND source_connection_id IN (
       SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
       INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
       WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
     )
     AND $__timeFilter(date)) ai,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
   WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) prs

panels.title: AI Lines / PR

panels.description: AI tokens consumed ÷ PRs merged, both sides scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(tok.n / NULLIF(prs.n, 0), 0) AS "Tokens / PR"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) n FROM ai_model_usages
   WHERE source_connection_id IN (
     SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
     INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
     WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
   )
   AND $__timeFilter(date)) tok,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
   WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) prs

panels.title: Tokens / PR

panels.description: AI spend ÷ PRs merged, both sides scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(spend.cost / NULLIF(prs.n, 0), 2) AS "Cost / PR"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(estimated_cost_usd) cost FROM ai_model_usages
   WHERE source_connection_id IN (
     SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
     INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
     WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
   )
   AND $__timeFilter(date)) spend,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
   WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) prs

panels.title: Cost / PR

panels.description: The 85th percentile of merged PR size (additions + deletions), scoped to the selected project(s). Computed exactly via row-numbering over the full size distribution, not approximated.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sizes AS (
  SELECT (pr.additions + pr.deletions) AS sz,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (pr.additions + pr.deletions)) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
)
SELECT sz AS "PR Size p85" FROM sizes WHERE rn = CEIL(0.85 * total) LIMIT 1

panels.title: PR Size p85 (lines changed)

panels.description: Weekly Cost/PR, Tokens/PR, and AI Lines/PR (real values, not indexed to a baseline), each with a week-over-week % change and direction arrow combined into the same cell. Both sides of every ratio (AI-side numerator, PR-side denominator) are scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). This is the primary view for this panel group — see the trend-shape chart below for a normalized, at-a-glance version of the same data.

targets.rawSql:
WITH weekly_prs AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_spend AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS v
  FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_tok AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS v
  FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_lines AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(lines_added) AS v
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND source_connection_id IN (
      SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT week FROM weekly_prs
  UNION SELECT week FROM weekly_spend
  UNION SELECT week FROM weekly_tok
  UNION SELECT week FROM weekly_lines
),
filled AS (
  SELECT w.week,
    COALESCE(s.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS cost_per_pr,
    COALESCE(t.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS tok_per_pr,
    COALESCE(l.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS lines_per_pr
  FROM weeks w
  LEFT JOIN weekly_prs p ON p.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_spend s ON s.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_tok t ON t.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_lines l ON l.week = w.week
),
rounded AS (
  SELECT week,
    ROUND(cost_per_pr, 2) AS cost_per_pr,
    ROUND(tok_per_pr, 0) AS tok_per_pr,
    ROUND(lines_per_pr, 1) AS lines_per_pr
  FROM filled
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT week, cost_per_pr, tok_per_pr, lines_per_pr,
    LAG(cost_per_pr) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS cost_per_pr_prev,
    LAG(tok_per_pr) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS tok_per_pr_prev,
    LAG(lines_per_pr) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS lines_per_pr_prev
  FROM rounded
)
SELECT week AS "Week",
  CONCAT(CONCAT('$', FORMAT(cost_per_pr,2)),
    CASE
      WHEN cost_per_pr_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN cost_per_pr_prev = 0 AND cost_per_pr = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN cost_per_pr_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN cost_per_pr > cost_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(cost_per_pr-cost_per_pr_prev)/cost_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN cost_per_pr < cost_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(cost_per_pr_prev-cost_per_pr)/cost_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "Cost / PR",
  CONCAT(FORMAT(tok_per_pr,0),
    CASE
      WHEN tok_per_pr_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN tok_per_pr_prev = 0 AND tok_per_pr = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN tok_per_pr_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN tok_per_pr > tok_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(tok_per_pr-tok_per_pr_prev)/tok_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN tok_per_pr < tok_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(tok_per_pr_prev-tok_per_pr)/tok_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "Tokens / PR",
  CONCAT(lines_per_pr,
    CASE
      WHEN lines_per_pr_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN lines_per_pr_prev = 0 AND lines_per_pr = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN lines_per_pr_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN lines_per_pr > lines_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(lines_per_pr-lines_per_pr_prev)/lines_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN lines_per_pr < lines_per_pr_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(lines_per_pr_prev-lines_per_pr)/lines_per_pr_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "AI Lines / PR"
FROM lagged
ORDER BY week DESC

panels.title: Cost / Tokens / AI Lines per PR — Weekly, with WoW % Change

panels.description: Each metric here is indexed to its own first non-zero week in the selected range, which is forced to exactly 100 — every other week is shown as a percentage of that one week's value, not as a real number. This makes the chart fragile whenever that first week happens to have a tiny real denominator: a first week with just 1 merged PR, for example, would make a completely normal later week with 17 PRs show as 1700%. Read this chart for trend shape only — use the table above for the real weekly values.

targets.rawSql:
WITH weekly_prs AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_spend AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS v
  FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_tok AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS v
  FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_lines AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(lines_added) AS v
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND source_connection_id IN (
      SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT week FROM weekly_prs
  UNION SELECT week FROM weekly_spend
  UNION SELECT week FROM weekly_tok
  UNION SELECT week FROM weekly_lines
),
filled AS (
  SELECT w.week,
    COALESCE(s.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS cost_per_pr,
    COALESCE(t.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS tok_per_pr,
    COALESCE(l.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS lines_per_pr
  FROM weeks w
  LEFT JOIN weekly_prs p ON p.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_spend s ON s.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_tok t ON t.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_lines l ON l.week = w.week
)
SELECT week,
  ROUND(cost_per_pr * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT cost_per_pr FROM filled f WHERE f.cost_per_pr > 0 ORDER BY f.week LIMIT 1), 0), 1) AS `Cost / PR`,
  ROUND(tok_per_pr * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT tok_per_pr FROM filled f WHERE f.tok_per_pr > 0 ORDER BY f.week LIMIT 1), 0), 1) AS `Tokens / PR`,
  ROUND(lines_per_pr * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT lines_per_pr FROM filled f WHERE f.lines_per_pr > 0 ORDER BY f.week LIMIT 1), 0), 1) AS `AI lines / PR`
FROM filled
ORDER BY week

panels.title: Cost / Tokens / AI Lines per PR — Indexed (Weekly, Trend Shape Only)

panels.description: Monthly p85 (solid) and median (dashed) of merged PR size (additions + deletions), scoped to the selected project(s). A widening gap between the two lines means a small number of oversized PRs are pulling the p85 up while the typical PR stays small — a signal worth watching for review-quality risk.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sizes AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.merged_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, (pr.additions + pr.deletions) AS sz
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT month, sz,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY sz) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY month) AS total
  FROM sizes
)
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(month, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, 'p85' AS metric, sz AS value FROM ranked WHERE rn = CEIL(0.85 * total)
UNION ALL
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(month, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'median', sz FROM ranked WHERE rn = CEIL(0.5 * total)
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: PR Size: p85 vs Median (lines changed, monthly)

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
ORDER BY p.name;

FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
ORDER BY p.name;

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$'
ORDER BY c.team_slug;

    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$'
